default_in_repayment.text: According to the information and explanation given to us and the records examined by us, the company has not been declared as a wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or any other lender

fraud.text: According to the information and explanations given to us and records examined by us, no fraud by the Company or no fraud on the Company by its officers or employees has been noticed or reported during the year. Accordingly, there were no instances which necessitated filing of report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act in Form ADT – 4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government.

statutory_dues.text: According to the information and explanations given to us, the company is regular in depositing its dues in respect of Goods & Service Tax, provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income-tax, sales tax, service tax, duty of customs, duty of excise, value added tax, cess. We were informed by the management that there were no dues under any other statues. There are no arrears of undisputed amounts payable as at year-end for a period of more than 6 months from the date they became payable.

call_points.text: FY27 growth to exceed FY26's, but Q1's 40% run-rate is not practicable for the full year.
FY27 capex guided at only ₹50-60 Cr, mostly maintenance.
S400 certification from GE USA received on 13 August; revenue potential to be known a couple of quarters later.
Aluminium plant JV with NALCO recommended for closure by both boards; awaiting ministry approval.
Metal bank is customer-owned and MIDHANI-operated, so it does not sit on MIDHANI's books or release working capital.
Margins depend on product mix; super alloy and titanium carry higher margins than special steel.

guidance.statement: Management targets 15% top-line growth and 23-25% EBITDA margins for FY27.
FY27 growth to be higher than FY26's, though Q1's 40% run-rate is not practicable for the full year
EBITDA margin to normalise to about 20-21% from Q3FY27
FY27 capex of ₹50-60 Cr, mostly maintenance
Exports to reach about 10% of turnover, rising 10-15% annually over three to four years

operating_notes.text: Order book position stood at ₹2,290 Cr as on April 1, 2026.
Metal bank being established to secure critical raw materials within 3-4 months.
Order book of ₹2,329 Cr as on 1 July 2026, with defence at 66%, space/ISRO 21%, energy 9% and others 4%.
Titanium orders worth about ₹600 Cr in hand; 750 tonnes melted last year at the new titanium facility.
Scrap inventory reduced by ₹17 Cr in Q1FY27, after a ₹75 Cr reduction last year.
Signed MoU with HWB and BARC for recovery of nickel and cobalt from plant reverts.

timeline.summary: BSE and NSE imposed fines of ₹4.96 lakh each on Midhani for board composition non-compliance for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹552.75 Cr (+34.6% YoY), net profit ₹77.9 Cr (+38.6% YoY).
Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited held Q4 FY26 Analysts/Investors Meet on June 3, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 11:50 AM, with recording available on its website.
On June 3, 2026, Mishra Dhatu Nigam held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15% revenue growth and outlining a ₹1,000 Cr capex plan.
On 17 August 2026, MIDHANI's Q1FY27 call reported revenue up 40.46% to ₹239.49 Cr and PAT up 27.42% to ₹16.31 Cr, with EBITDA margin at 20% on LPG and raw-material cost inflation.
Mishra Dhatu Nigam signed an MoU with HWB and BARC on October 27, 2026, to collaborate on the recovery of nickel and cobalt from plant reverts.
